report.10mb_interpretation: When the base is below 10MB, total-mode enforcement is a no-op for forgetting, but compaction and before/after accounting still run. Identical survivor sets are an inactive-capacity result, not evidence of equivalence under pressure.
report.approval_simulation: Consolidation approvals are deterministic harness actions on isolated local vaults; no person or live model reviewed proposals. The repository API records a human-role decision because that is its only supported reviewer identity.
report.budget_mode: actual total allocated-vault bytes enforced via repository budget_mode=total

fixture.capacity_text_note: Natural bilingual content is preserved; deterministic per-record alphabetic capacity tokens bring each body to about 1.1 KB. Only the ten declared duplicate pairs share those tokens.

review_simulation.fallback: FIFO hard forget if still over target
